cause_quote: The new readGeneratedPluginModelCatalogProviders returns `{ ...discovered, ...metadata, ... }`, so the hosted catalog row's `compat` replaced the live-listed model's discovered compat, including its supportedReasoningEfforts list.
user_saw: The reasoning-effort picker offered effort levels the account did not support, because the catalog's wider list overwrote the account's reported list.
summary: When describing a live-listed model with hosted catalog metadata, the registry now keeps the account-reported supportedReasoningEfforts (including an empty list) and the discovered compat when the catalog has none.
reasoning: Before #200403 generated (live-listed) provider rows were used as discovered, so the account's effort list reached the picker; cacbd460 added the catalog-description merge in which `...metadata` overwrites `compat` wholesale. The fix PR names #200403 as the source of the overwrite, the blame of the changed lines points only to it, and the same day the main real-Gateway UI test failed on it.
